testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive elements (sidebar links, buttons, tab triggers, context selectors) MUST contain data-testid attributes in kebab-case, e.g., data-testid='sidebar-pcf-studio-link'
testing_and_accessibility.wcag_compliance: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text on dark slate and light backgrounds

instructions_to_main_agent: Place PCF Studio sidebar item directly above Supplier Assessment in frontend/src/config/sidebarConfig.js
Do NOT alter or rewrite any uploaded PCF engine code; embed via a seamless React wrapper component with context bridging
Configure entitlement key 'pcf_studio' in entitlement lists and route guards
Reuse SustainRepo organization and facility contexts seamlessly
All new UI React components must use .js or .jsx extensions
